model.description: Breathe Free brings you Blueberry N' Strawberry, a 3-pack of 1g pre-rolls delivering 3g total of premium cannabis flower. Each perfectly rolled joint combines sweet blueberry and fresh strawberry flavors for a deliciously fruity smoking experience that's convenient and ready to enjoy. These pre-rolls offer a smooth, flavorful smoke with notes of ripe berries that dance across your palate from first puff to last. Ideal for sharing with friends or savoring solo, this 3-pack ensures you're always prepared for any occasion. The convenient pre-roll format eliminates prep work—just light up and enjoy the natural berry fusion. Perfect for cannabis enthusiasts seeking quality flower in an easy-to-use format with mouthwatering flavor profiles.
